The Mutagen Staff's flasks and elixir use the Alchemist flasks' own sounds (his note). Slots he left alone keep what plays now, at 20%. Nov 26 afternoon (doc XziAfzRj): the Wyrmspine Javelin's draw (with fire), throw (Ember bolt) and landing (Fwoosh). Nov 26 evening (doc 2S9Qv1, his "fix all of those problems" for the Issues tab's generic sounds and same-sounding swings): every slot he hadn't set takes the doc's recommended option (marked rec), weapons' draw, swing, heavy and hit too.
